group_id
required
200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully retrieve the details of the specified
scanner group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the scanner
group was created.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the scanner
group was last modified.
integer
The unique ID of the owner of the scanner group.
string
The username of the owner of the scanner group.
integer
The access permissions for the Default group.
integer
The sharing permissions for the scanner group.
integer
Indicates whether or not the scanner group is shared.
integer
The number of scans currently tasked to the scanner group.
string
The number of scanners associated with this scanner group.
string
The UUID of the scanner group.
string
The unique token for a scanner group.
string
The flag indicating what type of scanner group.
string
creation_date
last_modification_date
owner_id
owner
default_permissions
user_permissions
shared
scan_count
scanner_count
uuid
token
flag
type
The type of scanner group. This is set to "load_balancing" by
default.
string
The name of the scanner group.
string
The name of the network object associated with the scanner
group. For more information about network objects, see Manage
Networks.
integer
The unique ID of the scanner group.
boolean
Indicates whether or not the scanner group supports Tenable
Web App Scanning scanners.
integer
The unique scanner ID of the scanner group.
string
The UUID of the scanner group.
string
The username of the owner of the scanner group.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view the scanner group details.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management could not find the specified scanner group.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
